notes:
- The parent card on a title's page opens the title it names: The dashboard's "Sequel to ..." line learned to open its parent in 1.8.3, and the same sentence on a title's own page had the same symptom for a different reason: the card was built with no callback parameter at all, so there was nothing a tap could call.
- The new mark on a message clears when you open it: Messages marked a received row as new by comparing it against the moment you last read the inbox.
- Device Manager: the phone's own controls on one page: What the phone reports and what it lets the app do were in four pages, because each control was written beside the feature that first needed it - the refresh-rate ceiling and the cover cache under the seasonal sky, full-screen mode under the theme that stores it, the app lock under the session it gates and the hold duration under the cards it acts on.
- Full screen no longer leaves the top of the screen unpainted: Hiding the system bars put the window's breathing-room inset on the app's root surface, and an inset shrinks the thing it is applied to - so the painted area moved down with the content and the band where the status bar had been was drawn by the platform rather than by AniSequel.
- The people in your lists are shown against their own banners: Followers, following and a "Liked by" sheet were columns of an avatar and a name, and forty of those is a search.
- A profile banner is taller, and a wide one drifts on its own: The header went from 260 to 300dp.
- Nothing is off the edge of the attach-size row, and an upload says it is working: The five widths a photo or GIF can be embedded at sat in a horizontally scrolling row, which put "100%" off the right edge on a phone - and a control that looks static does not invite a swipe, so it read as full width having been removed.
